# Hyo

Hyo applies the Hyo design system as a warm, earthy interface with a white editor, a parchment sidebar and soft peach accents. Light and dark modes are both available, so the appearance can follow the way the vault is used.

![Hyo screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/evielync/hyo-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Hyo"
    author: "Ev Chapman"
    repo:   "evielync/hyo-theme"
    slug:   "hyo"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/hyo"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/evielync/hyo-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/evielync/hyo-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply the Hyo design system for a warm, earthy interface with a white editor, parchment sidebar, and soft peach accents. Switch between light and dark modes to match your workflow."
}
```
